objective: Qualify accession-level acceptance-clock and filing-party authority before any timestamp repair or financial rerun.

current_evidence.clock_certification: Still blocked: wall-clock agreement and conditional Eastern conversion are not field-clock authority.
current_evidence.qualification_limit: A small stratified pilot cannot certify the full cohort. Apparently agreeing or insensitive records are not automatically correct.

work: Freeze input hashes and deduplicated accession/role inventory; retain all source clocks and CIKs without choosing a winner.
Confirm the allowed metadata fields and periods against every return and fundamental seal. If scope is unclear, stop before a new source response is opened.
Define knowledge time as the existing registered acceptance-clock contract. Do not substitute report date, filing date, server Date, last-modified, processing time or feed receipt.
Specify role-aware parsing for transmitting agent, filer, subject company and co-registrants; a list of header CIKs or accession prefix is not an issuer/security mapping.
Rehearse normal, missing, conflicting, multi-party, DST-fold/gap, oversized and blocked-source cases using synthetic fixtures and existing caches.
stages.required_before_network: An accepted observation envelope, implemented/tested strict request adapter and a prospective metadata-only roster. This file is not acquisition permission.

sources: Official SEC EDGAR API field documentation
Applicable versioned EDGAR Filer Manual/header-field documentation
stages.record: Exact URL, document/version/applicability dates, retrieval UTC, content hash and the field-specific clock definition. Keep syntax claims separate from accuracy guarantees.
stop_if: Only general EDGAR operating hours or ISO Z syntax is documented, not the relevant field clock.
Current documentation cannot support the historical source versions being audited.
A response is blocked, gated, a JavaScript shell, unavailable or otherwise unqualified.
stages.decision: No implicit promotion of either internal source. If field-clock authority remains unresolved, stop with an evidence gap before the live accession pilot; a later conditional-evidence objective requires an explicit new decision.

selection.rule: After observation-envelope acceptance, sample8withoutreplacement from each exclusive pool using sorted accession IDs and a fixed RNG; no source-adjudication result or financial outcome affects selection.
selection.boundary_definition: Candidate instants cross a UTC calendar month/year or the existing planner flags a civil-clock issue; this is a sampling feature, not actual market impact.
selection.season_definition: Use the displayed pair timestamp's named New York offset only as a winter/summer sampling label, not as clock authority.
selection.shortfall_policy: Stop before HTTP if any accepted pool has fewer than8; do not backfill, remap or select a convenient replacement.

stages.scope: Acceptance timestamps and filing-party roles only. No document bodies, exhibits, statements, signal scores, prices, returns or event outcomes.
stages.handling: Preserve raw clocks and role fields; only add a candidate/qualified UTC instant when the documented clock is applicable and the civil-time mapping is unique. Multi-party uncertainty is not resolved by first-CIK or name similarity. Missing is unknown, never agreement or zero.
stages.pass_to_next_stage: All48selectedcases accounted for; no budget/seal/access breach; independent review accepts the source definitions and explicit unresolved classes. Any unresolved class blocks certification of records in it. Zero sampled errors never certifies unobserved filings.

work: Review the pilot before proposing any scale-up. Preserve every failed/unresolved case.
Compute an exact unique accession/role URL cache-miss roster for the intended used cohort, not a rounded claim that seventeen thousand requests will close everything.

The current inventory lacks headers for21480metadata rows and for17372sensitiveaccessions. These are row-level gaps, not automatically unique request counts; co-registrant paths, index requirements and unresolved definitions matter.
Approve a new explicit request/time budget before exceeding the historical150-attempt ceiling. Do not transfer unused pilot requests into extra cases automatically.
Require per-accession provenance and uncertainty for every used record. No universal four/five-hour shift or automatic pair/bulk substitution.

Recompute clock-driven assignments under the registered cached calendar before any separate financial rerun. Calendar/early-close validity, dated SIC/shares/security mapping and terminal payoffs remain distinct unresolved concerns.
stages.limits: Stratified sampling is diagnostic, not population error-rate estimation without weights and not scientific approval of H0/H1/H6.

proposed_request_contract.access_boundary: Only ordinary public HTTPS and a locally configured SEC-compliant contact User-Agent. No accounts, keys, paid feed, contact with people, alternate headers/identities, proxy bypass or retries after a block.
proposed_request_contract.cache: Use checksum-pinned ignored cache; cache hits consume no request. Count every network attempt before sending. Keep raw metadata/headers and retrieval/ETag/last-modified separately from acceptance time. Oversized responses are explicitly unread/unknown, not silently truncated or treated as clock agreement.
proposed_request_contract.implementation_readiness: The existing EdgarClient has retries and redirect following; it is NOT qualified unchanged for this strict pilot. A scoped request adapter and negative budget/block/redirect tests are prerequisites, not implemented or run here.
proposed_request_contract.enforcement_limit: These are proposed cooperative checks, not an installed sandbox or network-permission grant.

expected_future_outputs: An append-only per-request attempt receipt including failed requests and cache provenance
A per-selected-accession clock/role adjudication table with explicit unknowns and evidence hashes
Coverage/reconciliation counts, source-version qualifications, resource usage and stop reasons
A separate proposed cohort-scale budget, or an explicit blocked verdict; no production overwrite
non_claims: No HTTP was performed, no roster selected, no source newly cleared, no correction or CIK remap written, no holdout opened and no financial result or inference gate lifted.

validation.reason: Proposal/data/docs only; no request adapter implemented or acquisition executed.
